snippet.title: Karma: Curse of the 12 Caves (Windows, 1995) Retro Review from Interactive Entertainment Magazine
snippet.description:
This review is from Interactive Entertainment Magazine (Episode 22 - March 1996) .  A multimedia CD-ROM magazine which ran for 23 issues.  More information about the magazine and download links for the discs can be found at  http://demu.org/ 

The video has been resized to 1440x1080.
